questions.question: Whom does Psalm 32 call blessed?
options: The one who gives freely to the poor
The one who fears the LORD always
The one whose transgression is forgiven
The one who walks in all God's ways
questions.answer: The one whose transgression is forgiven

questions.question: What happened when David kept silent about his sin?
options: His enemies surrounded him on every side
His friends all abandoned him in his distress
His wealth slipped away like the wind
His bones wasted away through his groaning
questions.answer: His bones wasted away through his groaning

questions.question: David says he acknowledged his sin and God forgave the iniquity of his sin.
I will instruct you and teach you in the way you should _____.
Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, O _____!
